trigger_condition: Date/project-filtered analytics run excludes the older sibling sharing a resumed log
potential_consequence: No boundary for the older sibling; the resumed session's window opens at its start, so its pre-start records are dropped or misattributed.

trigger_condition: Sibling load or loadAgentSessionFile throws or is slow across all stored sessions
guard_snippet: try { siblings = await loadSiblings() } catch { siblings = [] }
potential_consequence: Single-session report aborts, or resolves every session's log path, for a boundary lookup.

trigger_condition: extraSiblings loadAgentSessionFile rejects for one sibling
potential_consequence: One unreadable sibling rejects buildWindows and fails the whole enrichCosts run.

trigger_condition: Session alone on its log (not shared) has records with ts earlier than its startTime
guard_snippet: only build windows for files with more than one session: if (list.length < 2) continue
potential_consequence: Records before recorded startTime (forked inherited history, clock skew) silently dropped from non-resumed sessions.

trigger_condition: Two sessions on one file share identical startTime (or both lack one, so 0)
guard_snippet: tie-break sort by sessionId and give tied sessions disjoint windows
potential_consequence: Both get the same window; the first in dedup order takes everything, the other gets zero.

trigger_condition: Dispatch event has non-finite start (NaN or undefined) and a window exists
potential_consequence: Dispatches without a start time are dropped for every session, including the first one.

trigger_condition: Kimi sessions resumed onto a shared log
potential_consequence: Kimi path ignores the window, so resumed shared logs are still double counted.
